entry.title: Select Board: agenda posted for the meeting of 29 September 2026
entry.summary: The town posted the agenda for the Select Board meeting of 29 September 2026. The agenda itself: https://www.lunenburgma.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_09292026-8040

entry.title: Select Board: the meeting of 15 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Select Board advanced the Food Pantry's temporary move to 30 School Street, waiving fees and OK'ing a license. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kig-BTakGjQ), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
